about: sheet-embed.1 validator vectors (docs/INTEGRATIONS.md, "Contract `sheet-embed.1`"). `parent`: messages a Workspace page sends (init on the window, the rest on the port), run through parseParentMessage; `embed`: messages Sheet sends, through parseEmbedMessage. `valid` is the verdict. An object that is exactly {"$bytes": "<base64>"} stands for an ArrayBuffer of those bytes; {"$bytes": "<base64>", "$length": n} for those bytes followed by zero bytes up to n bytes in all. Keys such as "__proto__" are own properties (as JSON.parse and a structured clone make them): decode with defineProperty, never assignment.
